provenance.client: mooo bridge (Mac 26.8.0 request shapes) on the owned B secondary profile; official Android 26.8.2 on A
provenance.method: Owned encrypted A/B/C regular group. The Matrix tester (the bridge account's user) sent heart, then thumbs-up, then redacted the thumbs-up on one synthetic text from A. A lab overlay recorded each inbound CHGLOGMETA's keys, legacy counts, extra keys, extra.my, the role of extra.userId and the type of extra.type, and counted connector-to-client calls. extra.type was recorded as a number but not by value; it equalled extra.my on all three pushes, inferred from the bridge's self-consistency check passing without a fallback read. Identifiers and revisions here are synthetic.

mooo_expected.note: The first push for the message reads /members because its stored roster was not yet confirmed on this session; the next two are derived from extra.my. The cancel itself sent only the cancel POST.
